title: VERY ATTRACTIVE BEDSKIRT
text: VERY ATTRACTIVE BEDSKIRT. Very happy with how this looks on our new King size bed.  It fits perfectly on our bed & makes it look great.

product_metadata.title: Clara Clark Premier 1800 Collection Solid Bed Skirt - 14" Drop Pleated Tailored Double Brushed Microfiber Dust Ruffle - Twin, Lilac Lavender
features: Clara Clark Bed Skirt are made of Double Brushed Microfiber, this fabric is resistant to tears and cuts, designed to last many years.
Twin size 39"x75" (99x190cm) with a 14” inch drop/fall, Tailored construction with neat pleats on all sides (2 in the front and 2 on the sides).
It’s not just a curtain for your bed but a nicely solid colored bed skirt that changes the entire feel of your room, pairs easily with our Clara Clark Bedding sets
The 14" Inch drop ensures that everything under your bed remains hidden such as the box spring and legs.
Fits nicely under your mattress making sure your bed skirt does not shift and is always in place, enabling the bed skirt to curtain all sides of your bed.
